Experience in CI/CD tools such as Git, GitLab

Experience with mocking services
Experience working with npm/yarn
React experience along with Node

cond_0537.responsibilities:
Create and maintain automated test cases
Execute test suites
Review and diagnose reported bugs, communicating findings clearly to ensure overall product quality prior to and during each product release cycle

Experience working with RESTful APIs
Experience in the test automation field (Selenium, and/or other Javascript-based frameworks)
Experience with frontend test automation (Webdriver IO and Mocha, Chai and/or Jest)
Experience working with npm/yarn
Experience in CI/CD tools such as Git, GitLab
React experience along with Node

The [Product name masked] is used by [Company name masked]'s Site Experience and Site Production teams to build and publish content for various sales and brand promotions across the web and native app. This team is one part of an overall multi-team digital [Product name masked].
cond_0618.responsibilities:
Create and maintain automated test cases, staying in regular contact with the team to keep coverage aligned with ongoing development.
Execute test suites and communicate results clearly to the team.
Review and diagnose reported bugs, actively raising issues early to ensure overall product quality prior to and during each product release cycle.
Participate actively in backlog refinement and sprint planning discussions for React and NodeJS web platforms (Content Management), speaking up to ensure test scenarios are considered.
cond_0618.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience with Playwright for front-end automation
Experience in the test automation field (Selenium and/or other JavaScript-based frameworks)
Experience with frontend test automation (Webdriver IO and Mocha, Chai and/or Jest)
Experience working with RESTful APIs
Experience in CI/CD tools such as Git, GitLab
Preferred Requirements
Experience with mocking services
Experience working with npm/yarn
React experience along with Node
cond_0618.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
